calibration_assumptions.forecast: hold current ONBOARD load for five 30 s steps
calibration_assumptions.material_reference_rule: five times squared Train p95 absolute one-step load change divided by 600 kW
calibration_assumptions.material_soc_rule: median positive five-step SOC penalty at SOC 0.4 and 0.6 under reference policy
calibration_assumptions.nominal_cost_rule: median positive five-step optimizer economic numerator over quantile-sampled Train origins
calibration_assumptions.reference: causal 180 s LPF preview; reset at each ONBOARD run
calibration_assumptions.reference_policy: clip each LPF reference to 0..600 kW FC
calibration_assumptions.reference_previous_fc: previous observed LPF value; not a replayed MPC command
calibration_assumptions.status: candidate calibration and open-loop response screen; no DQN training or Validation selection
